opening.argument: The title promotes a cryptocurrency trading bot with a stated “Profit +100%” claim, while the spoken description says, “This trading bot will work automatically, it also trades on Ethereum networks.” The access flow directs viewers to download and run software, including instructions to “Run AutoInstall.exe,” turn off VPN protection, and disable real-time protection. Those requirements go beyond ordinary trading information by directing viewers toward executable software under weakened device safeguards. The supplied application view further shows trading-style controls, numeric fields, transaction-log content, and a download-link banner. Taken together, the profit claim, automated trading offer, installation instructions, and security-disabling steps establish the promoted scheme as deceptive trading-bot returns.
